storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: The Kettle & Rook is warm and loud. A stranger in a saffron cloak sits alone by the stove, and Odrell Pim wipes a tankard behind the bar, the guest keys hanging on a hook at his elbow.

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened.

npcs.name: Odrell Pim
npcs.description: Round-shouldered innkeeper of the Kettle & Rook. Guards his guests' keys and distrusts liars. The stranger in the saffron cloak is Wen Tarrow, a paying guest.

playerLine: I lie to Odrell Pim: I tell him the stranger owes me money, and ask for the key to the stranger's room.
